title: Print Odd Items From a List

blocks.content: Print Odd Items From a List
Write a program to print odd integers from a numbers list.

items: Create a list named numbers with integers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
Use a for loop to iterate through numbers.
Inside the loop, print only odd integers.
